retired.quote_text: Adding is easy. Anyone can add. Deciding what doesn't belong is the job.
Everybody wants to add. Nobody wants to be the one who says this part is junk.
Great work is mostly refusal. The making is the easy half.
Ten good things will bury one great thing every single time.
The hardest part of the job isn't killing the bad work. It's killing the work that's already good.
The good ideas are the dangerous ones. Bad ideas die on their own; the good ones you have to kill yourself.
Say no until it's uncomfortable. Then say it twice more.
Most teams don't fail from bad ideas. They drown in good ones.
Shipping less than you wanted to isn't a compromise. It's the point.
